paragraphs.text: Bicycles left at the station for more than 14 days are removed by staff and taken to a secure store. To collect your bicycle, bring proof of ownership, such as a receipt or a photograph of you with the bike. A storage fee of £10 is charged.

items.quote: Bicycles left at the station for more than 14 days are removed by staff
items.prompt: Bicycles are removed if they are left at the station for more than 1 ____.

explanation.en: “left at the station for more than 14 days” → 14 days. £10 is the storage fee, not the time limit.
explanation.kk: «left at the station for more than 14 days» → 14 days. £10 — мерзім емес, сақтау ақысы.
explanation.ru: «left at the station for more than 14 days» → 14 days. £10 — плата за хранение, а не срок.

items.quote: bring proof of ownership, such as a receipt or a photograph
items.prompt: To collect a bicycle, owners must bring 2 ____ of ownership.

explanation.en: “bring proof of ownership” → proof. A “receipt” and a “photograph” are examples, and “of ownership” already follows the gap.
explanation.kk: «bring proof of ownership» → proof. «Receipt» пен «photograph» — дәлелдің мысалдары, ал бос орыннан кейін «of ownership» тұр.
explanation.ru: «bring proof of ownership» → proof. «Receipt» и «photograph» — примеры доказательства, а после пропуска уже стоит «of ownership».

groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. Look at the text. Complete the sentences below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.

steps.en: Limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. After “more than” expect a period: a number and maybe a word.
steps.kk: Шек: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. «More than» сөзінен кейін мерзім күтеміз: сан және мүмкін бір сөз.
steps.ru: Лимит: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER. После «more than» ждём срок: число и, возможно, слово.

steps.en: The first sentence: “Bicycles left at the station for more than 14 days are removed”.
steps.kk: Бірінші сөйлем: «Bicycles left at the station for more than 14 days are removed».
steps.ru: Первое предложение: «Bicycles left at the station for more than 14 days are removed».

steps.en: Answer: 14 days — one number and one word, within the limit.
steps.kk: Жауап: 14 days — бір сан және бір сөз, шектен аспайды.
steps.ru: Ответ: 14 days — одно число и одно слово, в пределах лимита.

steps.en: The gap is followed by “of ownership”, so we need the noun before “of”.
steps.kk: Бос орыннан кейін «of ownership» тұр — демек «of» алдындағы зат есім керек.
steps.ru: После пропуска «of ownership» — значит, нужно существительное перед «of».

steps.en: The text: “bring proof of ownership, such as a receipt or a photograph”.
steps.kk: Мәтінде: «bring proof of ownership, such as a receipt or a photograph».
steps.ru: В тексте: «bring proof of ownership, such as a receipt or a photograph».

steps.en: Answer: proof. “Receipt” fits the meaning but not the grammar — “receipt of ownership” is not said, and it is only an example.
steps.kk: Жауап: proof. «Receipt» мағынасы жағынан келеді, бірақ грамматикасы жағынан жоқ: «receipt of ownership» деп айтылмайды, бұл талаптың өзі емес, мысал.
steps.ru: Ответ: proof. «Receipt» подходит по смыслу, но не по грамматике: «receipt of ownership» так не говорят, и это пример, а не само требование.
